name: Claude (claude.ai) — new-chat composer, dark theme
source_note: Built 2026-10-09 from Jake's motion5 reference (claude.ai dark new-chat page, screen-captured from a YouTube video; frames measured at the clip's final zoom, 1 css px = 1.805 screen px). No UX Scout login exists for claude.ai (agentrec.scout_for('https://claude.ai') = None), so nothing was captured live. Colours are as the reference VIDEO shows them (YouTube encode, slightly darker than the live app); geometry in css px. See NOTES.md.

font_substitutes.prompt + UI: Claude renders the composer in the system sans (SF Pro on the reference Mac) → Inter

working.text_source: official claude.com/features/artifacts image (2026): spark + title ('Building the launch deck') + muted detail line with a moving highlight and a '>' chevron; official Claude Design image (claude.com/product/claude-design): spark + 'Tweaking…' with the highlight sweep. Labels other than those two are generic (verify).

shimmer.note: a lighter window sweeps left→right over the muted label (both official images catch it mid-sweep). Speed/period NOT measured (stills only) → verify_against_live. Templates set --cl-sweep-x each frame (no @keyframes).

spark.note: the spark animates while Claude works (clip 6 shows it under the streaming reply); exact motion unmeasured → a slow rotation is a placeholder (verify)

fill.sub: optional detail line (muted), e.g. 'Setting the headline'

user.source: official claude.com/features/artifacts image (2026, light): the user's message is a rounded bubble at the TOP RIGHT, sans text, darker than the page; Claude's activity starts at the left below it. Dark bubble colour = claude.ai's dark bg-300 mapped to the encode (verify).

stream.note: Jake's clip 6 (frame 1, paused mid-stream): the last ~10 characters of the reply ('aze at the') sit at 22 % opacity (measured: 80 vs 255 text / 32 page), the rest fully opaque; the spark sits under the last line. Wrap the newest chunk in <span class="clk-tail">; fade-in speed not measurable (the clip holds the frame).

text.source: Jake's clip 6 (serif reply, white, Gelasio metrics = kit.message), spark under the reply

privacy: Display name shown: Jake (greeting 'Evening, Jake'). No e-mail, avatar, chat history, org name or account id is part of this kit. The reference's own greeting name is never used.

message.name: Claude (claude.ai) — conversation view with one long assistant message, dark theme
message.source_note: Built 2026-10-09 from Jake's motion6 reference (claude.ai dark chat view, screen-captured; app content = capture y 60-1139, 1:1 at 1920x1080). Geometry in css px at the kit's scale (1 css px = 1.1651 screen px at the reference's start view: the composer is 727 css = 847 screen px wide, as in motion5). Colours as the reference VIDEO shows them. Nothing captured live (no claude.ai login for UX Scout).
message.disclaimer: Claude is AI and can make mistakes. Please double-check responses.

font_substitutes.message: Claude renders the reply in its serif (Georgia metrics in the reference: line widths match Georgia/Gelasio within 1 %) → Gelasio (OFL, Georgia-metric-compatible)

message.notes: The Claude conversation view: chat-title header (sidebar toggle + title; solid bg band that clips the scrolled text at css y 86.7), one assistant message in the serif (pre-wrapped plain text: section headings are just ALL-CAPS lines ending in ':' after a blank line — same size and weight as the body), the Claude spark under the message, and the docked composer ('Write a message...', +, model label, chevron, mic, voice) with the disclaimer line. Placeholders: {{content_html}} (the message text, already escaped/marked up by the template), {{title}} (chat title; empty = none), {{placeholder}}, {{model_label}} (kit.model_label), {{disclaimer}}. The template scrolls the element at scroll_sel (translateY) and draws marker highlights inside text_sel. Lead: merge as kit.message and add "Gelasio": "Gelasio.ttf" to kit.fonts. Reference values: message font 18.89 px / line pitch 29.0 px at the start view (screen px) = 16.21 / 24.89 css; text column 795.6 screen px (682.9 css; set so every reference line wraps where the reference wraps) starting at screen x 560; composer 847x121.5 screen px at (536.5, 914.5).
message.privacy: No names, e-mail, avatar, org or history. The reference's own chat title is NOT used (title is a parameter, default empty).
